faq.title: Everything you should know before joining.

items.question: Until when is the Founding Artist campaign available?
items.answer: The campaign is valid for artists who register until June 30, 2027.

items.question: When does my 2-year membership begin?
items.answer: Your 24-month membership begins immediately after your payment is successfully completed.

items.question: What will the price be after the campaign?
items.answer: After the Founding Artist campaign ends, the standard Artist membership will cost 49.99 USD per year.

items.question: Is the Founding Artist badge permanent?
items.answer: Yes. The Founding Artist badge will remain permanently on the profiles of artists who join during the campaign.

items.question: Will my membership renew automatically after 2 years?
items.answer: Yes. At the end of your 24-month membership, it will automatically renew at the standard annual membership price. You may cancel at least 30 days before renewal to avoid the next billing cycle.

items.question: When will my membership become active?
items.answer: Your Founding Artist membership becomes active immediately after your payment is successfully completed, and your 24-month membership period starts at the same time.
